shots.name: s01_day_1_banner
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic shot of bold yellow text 'DAY 1' at the top of a dark cinematic frame and a smaller subtitle 'teaching the internet to program AI' below. Yellow particles drift across the frame. Subtle scan lines flicker. Cyberpunk-tech aesthetic, photo-realistic, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: The bold DAY 1 text remains crisp. Yellow particles drift slowly. Subtle horizontal scan lines sweep. Continuous gentle dramatic motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: Day one of teaching the internet to program AI agents.
shots.subtitle: DAY 1: teaching the internet

shots.name: s02_with_thumbs
shots.image_prompt: Extreme close-up cinematic shot of a thumb pressing a glowing yellow heart icon on a phone screen. The heart bursts into yellow particles that fly upward. Bold yellow text 'WITH THEIR THUMBS' visible in the upper third. Cyberpunk-tech aesthetic, dramatic close-up, photo-realistic, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: Thumb continuously presses heart. Heart bursts into yellow particles flying upward. The text remains stable. Continuous tactile motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.subtitle: WITH THEIR THUMBS

shots.name: s03_what_i_shipped
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic shot of a futuristic translucent holographic GitHub-style commit graph in dark space. Yellow commit dots flow rapidly along the timeline. Bold yellow text 'WHAT I SHIPPED' in the upper third. Photo-realistic 3D render, atmospheric lighting, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: Yellow commit dots continuously flow along the graph. Slow camera dolly forward. The WHAT I SHIPPED text remains stable. Continuous flowing motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: Public repo. Live feed. Five real agent tasks.
shots.subtitle: what shipped today

shots.name: s04_loop_diagram
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic shot of a circular loop diagram in dark space. The loop shows mini icons along its path: a heart, a code block, a checkmark, a video. Yellow energy flows around the loop. Cyberpunk-tech aesthetic, atmospheric particle effects, photo-realistic 3D render, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: Yellow energy continuously flows around the loop. The icons pulse softly in sequence. Continuous rotational motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: Likes become signal. Signal becomes code.
shots.subtitle: the loop

shots.name: s05_tomorrow_promise
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic shot of yellow energy converging into the bold word 'TOMORROW' forming from converging light particles in dark space. Energy waves radiate outward. Cyberpunk-tech aesthetic, photo-realistic 3D render, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: Yellow particles continuously converge into the TOMORROW text. Energy waves radiate outward in concentric rings. Continuous gathering motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: Tomorrow, the agent picks the highest signal issue and ships a pull request.
shots.subtitle: first agent PR coming

shots.name: s06_cta
shots.image_prompt: Hero shot of the bold yellow Rally R logo glowing in dark void. Yellow particles orbit. Text 'rallysignal.co' below. Cyberpunk-tech aesthetic, ultra-dramatic atmospheric lighting, photo-realistic, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: The yellow R logo pulses with light. Yellow particles orbit slowly. Continuous gentle motion, hero ending shot, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: Comment merge if you'd build this.
shots.subtitle: comment 'merge' to vote
